name: Közlekedési Hatóság (Transport Authority)
notes: List correction: the README-derived 'Hungarian National Transport Authority' (NKH, nkh.gov.hu) is stale: nkh.gov.hu now returns 404 and the former Aviation Authority work sits on the Közlekedési Hatóság site kozlekedesihatosag.kormany.hu. Role confirmed on its page /hu/web/legugyi-szakterulet: civil aviation state tasks are designated by Government Decree 382/2016 (XII. 2.) and performed by the aviation departments (főosztály) under the Deputy State Secretariat for Transport Strategy and Authority Affairs of the transport ministry; military aviation is separate (Ministry of Defence). The site's header logo (nkh-theme/images/logo.png, tier 2 website-served, exact host in official_domains) is the ministry's government identity (Hungarian coat of arms plus 'Közlekedési és Beruházási Minisztérium'), not a separate logo of the authority; it is the only logo the site shows. No logo terms located, so redistribution rights are not confirmed.

gaps.need: authority's own logo, dark/white variant, brand guidelines
